summary: Create a Service Bus queue. This operation is idempotent.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: The queue name.

parameters.name: --namespace-name
parameters.help: The namespace name.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --auto-delete-on-idle
parameters.help: ISO 8061 timeSpan idle interval after which the queue is automatically deleted. The minimum duration is 5 minutes.

parameters.name: --default-message-time-to-live
parameters.help: ISO 8601 default message timespan to live value. This is the duration after which the message expires, starting from when the message is sent to Service Bus. This is the default value used when TimeToLive is not set on a message itself.

parameters.name: --duplicate-detection
parameters.help: A value indicating if this queue requires duplicate detection.

parameters.name: --duplicate-detection-history-time-window
parameters.help: ISO 8601 timeSpan structure that defines the duration of the duplicate detection history. The default value is 10 minutes.

parameters.name: --enable-batched-operations
parameters.help: Value that indicates whether server-side batched operations are enabled.

parameters.name: --enable-dead-lettering-on-message-expiration
parameters.help: A value that indicates whether this queue has dead letter support when a message expires.

parameters.name: --enable-express
parameters.help: A value that indicates whether Express Entities are enabled. An express queue holds a message in memory temporarily before writing it to persistent storage.

parameters.name: --enable-partitioning
parameters.help: A value that indicates whether the queue is to be partitioned across multiple message brokers.

parameters.name: --enable-session
parameters.help: A value that indicates whether the queue supports the concept of sessions.

parameters.name: --forward-dead-lettered-messages-to
parameters.help: Queue/Topic name to forward the Dead Letter message.

parameters.name: --forward-to
parameters.help: Queue/Topic name to forward the messages.

parameters.name: --lock-duration
parameters.help: ISO 8601 timespan duration of a peek-lock; that is, the amount of time that the message is locked for other receivers. The maximum value for LockDuration is 5 minutes; the default value is 1 minute.

parameters.name: --max-delivery-count
parameters.help: The maximum delivery count. A message is automatically deadlettered after this number of deliveries. default value is 10.

parameters.name: --max-message-size
parameters.help: Maximum size (in KB) of the message payload that can be accepted by the topic. This property is only used in Premium today and default is 1024.

parameters.name: --max-size
parameters.help: The maximum capacity of the queue, denoted in megabytes, signifies the volume of memory assigned to the queue. The permissible values for this parameter are 1024, 2048, 3072, 4096, and 5120 megabytes. By default, the system assigns a capacity of 1024 megabytes. If the ‘enable-partition’ setting is set to true, the specified queue size will be amplified by a factor of 16.

parameters.name: --status
parameters.help: Enumerates the possible values for the status of a messaging entity.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
